body:
I thought I would share my experience using 2C-B because after reading reports by others on their experiences with the substance, I was surprised to find mine was unique.  The aspect of my use of 2C-B that was different from other reports , was that I was told to snort the compound instead of taking it orally. This, I believe results in a very different experience.
The first and last time I used 2C-B was during junior year of high school. I took it with a group of friends one of whom produced a bag of white powder he said was 2C-B.  We all took turns snorting between 5 and 10mg each.  We waited and within 5 minutes we started to experience perceptual distortion of sight and sound. Over the next hour these distortions became more noticeable until we were all quite high.  Since then I have eaten low doses of dried psilocybin mushrooms and would describe the visuals to be slightly more powerful but similar to those of 2C-B snorted at around 10mg.  Early on in the 2C-B experience I noticed distinct tracers as I moved my hand in front of my face. Music from the stereo seemed to fill my skull and reverberate. I noticed a growing body high that felt like a warm blanket enveloped me. As the end of the first hour as the visuals peaked my attention was caught by the wood grain of the kitchen table seeming to move and crawl. Sitting down we played a computer game and the rainbow of pixels on the screen was fascinating.  After about two hours, the drug began to wear off and after three we had come down completely.
In retrospect it was a very interesting experience and I would like to try 2C-B again at 15 or 20mgs.
